overview_description.description: Sendblue is a business messaging platform that helps companies send and receive iMessage, SMS, and RCS from their CRM, workflows, AI agents, and custom applications. Its REST API and integrations let sales, support, ecommerce, healthcare, and developer teams add native blue-bubble iMessage conversations to tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Zendesk, Intercom, Zapier, Make, and custom software.
